method.compilation: One direct LuaLaTeX pass with tags and links active, starting without auxiliary files.
method.instrumentation: Temporary xparse wrapper around every footnote; os.clock CPU-time deltas were accumulated around the original macro.
method.instrumentation_overhead: One matched pair differed by 1.459523 seconds (0.418%); one pair is insufficient for a reliable estimate.

footnote_profile.interpretation: Intervals include footnote typesetting and work executed inside the original footnote macro. They do not isolate hyperref, tagpdf, page shipping, or marker overhead.

comparison.note: The source hash recorded in the initial convergence metrics was measured before media derivative preparation; write_latex_pdf renders the compiler source again after preparation. The profile's uninstrumented source hash matches that post-preparation compiler source. The timing still does not isolate the notes' cost across all converged passes.

limits: One direct pass; auxiliary references are not converged.
The seven missing table-of-contents links relative to the converged PDF are expected for a first pass without a populated TOC.
No comparison with the same source compiled without instrumentation was made.
Only one matched pair measured the instrumentation overhead, so no reliable estimate is available.
The timing is diagnostic and does not justify a production change.
